;*************************************************************
;*************************************************************
;**                                                         **
;**       arcsin(arccos(arctan(tan(cos(sin(9°))))))-9       **
;**                                                         **
;*************************************************************
;*************************************************************

; Real version
In: FL_SPCRES=0 FL_CPXRES=0 SD=0 RMODE=0 AM=DEG FL_ASLIFT=0 FL_CPXRES=0 RX=Real:"9"
Func: fnSin
Out:  EC=0
Func: fnCos
Out:  EC=0
Func: fnTan
Out:  EC=0
Func: fnArctan
Out:  EC=0
Func: fnArccos
Out:  EC=0
Func: fnArcsin
Out:  EC=0
Func: fnSwapXY
Out:  EC=0
Func: fnSubtract
In:   RX=Real:"9"
Out:  EC=0 FL_CPXRES=0 RX=Real:"-6.2465e-29":DEG


;*************************************************************
;*************************************************************
;**                                                         **
;**      Argument reduction of an angle far past 2pi:       **
;**      WP34S_Mod and WP34S_BigMod (wp34s.c), reached      **
;**      through mod2Pi and longIntegerAngleReduction.      **
;**                                                         **
;*************************************************************
;*************************************************************

; real 1E700 in radians: mod2Pi -> WP34S_BigMod
Func: fnSin
In:  AM=RAD FL_SPCRES=0 FL_ASLIFT=0 FL_CPXRES=0 SD=0 RMODE=0 RX=Real:"1E700"
Out: EC=0 FL_ASLIFT=1 RL=Real:"1E700" RX=Real:"-0.9999988151254254966855748665509861"

; the same angle as a long integer: longIntegerAngleReduction -> WP34S_Mod.
; L asserts that the operand reaches last-x still a long integer
Func: fnSin
In:  AM=RAD FL_SPCRES=0 FL_ASLIFT=0 FL_CPXRES=0 SD=0 RMODE=0 RX=LonI:""
Out: EC=0 FL_ASLIFT=1 RL=LonI:"" RX=Real:"-0.9999988151254254966855748665509861"

; degrees, where the reducer is WP34S_Mod against const_360
Func: fnSin
In:  AM=DEG FL_SPCRES=0 FL_ASLIFT=0 FL_CPXRES=0 SD=0 RMODE=0 RX=Real:"1E700"
Out: EC=0 FL_ASLIFT=1 RL=Real:"1E700" RX=Real:"-0.9848077530122080593667430245895230"
